title: Reincarnation joke and chase exit
summary: The black goat and reincarnation baboon jokes, ending with a chase tap exit.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Did you dance to it when he played?

Yeah. But it was -- what a dance. It was just a short little ditty, you know. It was a fast, up-tempo dance, just to sell his instrument, his playing of the instrument, you see. And I only did like 32 bars of tap dancing, you see, and that was that. Then we had some old jokes, we told some old jokes about, "What was you doing with that old black goat I seen you with?" I'd say, "Well, my black goat can give white milk," and he said, "Well, that ain't nothing." And I'd say, "Well, can you give it?" Or, he asked me, he says, "I do a little tap dancing," and I'd stop, and he says, "That was good." I'd say, "I know it." He'd say, "Chuck, did your father and mother give you money to learn how to tap dance like that?" I'd say, "They sure did." He said, "Well, what did you do with the money?" Then we'd get into a little fight, and he'd shove me away and I'd run at him, and he'd throw up his foot, you see. He's got the advantage in the fight. So he'd say, "Keep it up, so I can reincarnate you." And I said -- and I laughed. And he said, "What you laughing for?" I said, "There you go, talking about reincarnation, and

you don't even know what kind of flower that is." And he laughs, and I say, "What you laughing for?" He said, "Reincarnation ain't no flower. That means when you die you comes back in the form of some kind of animal." So I said, "Is that what that is?" He says, "Sure." And I'd say, "Sure is." And that gets a laugh. And I asked him, "Well, Chuckles, when you die and come back, what kind of animal are you going to be?" He said, "Well," and he looks me up and down, "I think I'll come back in the form of a baboon so I can get even with you." So then I laugh, and he said, "Man, what are you laughing for?" I said, "Man, you can't come back into the same thing twice." Then the band would strike up some music and we'd do a tap dance and exit.
That's a funny routine. That's a funny routine. So what kind of dancing would you exit with?
Well, we would exit with a chase. We'd be chasing each other, see. It would take two people to do that. It was a chase tap dance, see.
Yeah. He'd be chasing me and I'd wind up circling him and chasing him off, like that.
